description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy values for three sentiment-analysis approaches (VADER, TextBlob, and ChatGPT) as part of an evaluation comparing ChatGPT against other algorithms. The category axis is the horizontal axis, showing three labeled categories in left-to-right order: “VADER,” “TextBlob,” and “ChatGPT,” with the axis label reading “Evaluation of ChatGPT VS various algorithms.” The value axis is the vertical axis labeled “Accuracy,” displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0.4 to 1.0, with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals (0.4, 0.5, …, 1.0). Each category has a single bar: VADER is shown as a white bar with a black outline at approximately 0.69 accuracy, TextBlob is shown as a white bar with a black outline and diagonal hatch pattern at approximately 0.66 accuracy, and ChatGPT is shown as a solid green bar at approximately 0.94 accuracy. A legend at the right identifies the encodings for VADER (plain white), TextBlob (hatched), and ChatGPT (green). The bars are not presented as grouped or stacked sets, and there are no visible annotations on individual bars beyond the legend and axis labels; the ChatGPT bar is visually emphasized by its distinct green fill compared to the monochrome styling of the other two bars.
